headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 24, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 15.41% compared to SPY's 9.04%. This results in an average alpha of 6.36%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has delivered an impressive return of 46.59%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' has returned 8.83%, which still aligns positively relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, as it reflects the portfolio's resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
